Docs.summary: Base attribute class for generated proxy types that enable AOT-safe type mapping between Java and .NET types.
Docs.remarks: Proxy attributes are generated at build time and applied to the proxy type itself (self-application pattern). The .NET runtime's GetCustomAttribute<JavaPeerProxy>() instantiates the proxy in an AOT-safe manner — no Activator.CreateInstance() needed.
